text: Acceptance 14 (notifications, search): a deep link to a THREAD reply opens the channel but not the thread, so the mention cannot be found. Repro: bell -> '@nestor called you #general' (msg 25, threadId 1) -> #general opens, no .thread, no .flash; Cmd+K 'flushpackets' -> Enter on the #bugs hit (msg 10, threadId 8) -> same. Cause: openConversation(convId, msgId) scrolls only the main list (widok-czat.js:49-70); widoczneWiadomosci drops threadId rows (stan.js:292). Fix: open the thread and flash.
